summary: Diff implements the requested UX/content enhancements on the homepage (hero CTAs, trust signals, testimonials, FAQ), adds a /request-quote page and route, implements backend storage/admin management for quote inquiries, and adds an /admin/leads page with status updates. A couple of footer additions appear outside the requested scope.

hallucinated_features.description: Added social media 'Connect' section with placeholder links in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-13 asked for service-company footer improvements (contact block, service area text, quick links) and explicitly disallowed third-party integrations; social links were not requested as part of the acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Added external attribution link to caffeine.ai with UTM parameters in the footer.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested in any REQ-9–REQ-13 acceptance criteria; introduces an external marketing/referral-style link with tracking parameters.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin leads management includes an "adminNotes" editing workflow (dialog/textarea) beyond required status updates.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-12 requires listing inquiries and enabling status updates; adding admin notes editing is extra functionality not explicitly requested.
